Graph, Canvas and Bases domain contracts compile with the shared TypeScript core.
No issues in the changed Graph, Canvas, Bases and fixture files.

limitations: The Bases parser currently covers the repository's version 1 JSON fixture grammar; YAML/reference Obsidian behavior and embedded live views remain pending.
